scope.summary: Implement effect styles + presets on the StudioStyleRegistry: a StudioEffectStack (or any sub-range) savable as a named reusable effect style (live reference - updating the style updates every applying layer), publishable across documents, deduping effect-styles/graphic-styles/saved-filter-presets into one primitive; per-filter/gallery/lighting/warp parameter sets savable as presets through the same registry; applying an effect style is a typed command through the propose-work lifecycle (14.18). Preset assets (textures, displacement maps, custom kernels, material graphs) referenced via document-relative/configured asset roots - NO absolute/machine-local paths (portability posture). Operator-visible styles picker.
acceptance_criteria: effect styles (live reference) + per-filter/gallery/lighting/warp presets on StudioStyleRegistry; portable asset refs; operator-visible picker
expected_tests: test: effect style live reference (update style -> updates all applying layers); per-filter/gallery/lighting/warp presets savable; apply via propose-work
test: preset assets referenced via document-relative/configured roots (no absolute path); portability move test
argus: styles picker reachable stable author_ids

risk_if_missed: No reusable effect styles/presets; effect library non-portable.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
